values.note: Pit toilets, fire rings, a boat ramp and shade trees; bring your own firewood (collecting it on the refuge is prohibited).

values.note: Camping is limited to 14 days within a 28-day period; camping on the refuge only at the designated sites of Crook and Swinging Bridge.

booking.source: https://www.fws.gov/locations/browns-park-national-wildlife-refuge/camping ('we do not take campsite reservations; all campsites are first-come first-served'; 'Camping is limited to 14 days within a 28-day period.'), read 2026-10-28

note: Browns Park National Wildlife Refuge (USFWS, not BLM), at the southeast end of Wildlife Drive: primitive drive-in sites under cottonwoods, with a gravel boat ramp on the Green River; pack out trash. Drive-in via long gravel Browns Park Rd (passable by normal vehicle). Aggregators list 'small RVs only / ~20 ft' (FWS gives no length) - confirm the specific site on arrival. --Claude
summary: FWS refuge camping page: confirmed 10 sites, free, first-come only, no reservations, 14 days in 28, year-round, pit toilets, no potable water; phone 970-365-3613 confirmed on the refuge page. Cleared the note-derived pull_through (FWS silent). Riverview consistent on imagery: the loop sits under the cottonwoods along Wildlife Drive ~100-170 m from the Green River behind a riparian strip, with the boat-ramp spur reaching the bank. No closure notice. Note trimmed of field repeats.
